Use case: precise-object-edit. Output one complete 1536×1024 literary-room STUDY mother. Keep the exact full canvas and source positions of Image 1; change only the small arm/gaze activity needed for studying.

Literary expression: 她不急着替你答，认真把这一行读到自己也懂。她留住对方已经走通的尝试，把那个看似基础、却还没接上的关系安放在明亮处；不是摆出熟练的讲解者姿态，而是自己也耐心读清这一行。安定、专注，唇线自然中性，眉间有很轻的推敲；清楚的蓝眼睛落回真实桌面的页上。Keep Soyo's individual quiet judgment and warmth, without an automatic smile, frowning drama or a hostess pose.

Critical invariants: preserve Image 1's exact original LEFT desk dimensions/top/front and drawers, the SAME locally angled wooden chair and seated hip/legs, the ROUND porcelain-lamp table still at original x≈435–690, all lamp/cup/flower/book positions, window bench/pillows/throw, original large wood window/lake-town view/curtains, shelves/plants/art/floor/rug and foreground plant. Do not enlarge the desk, shift the round table, translate the chair toward camera, change perspective, crop or create more room for a frontal figure. The plant's natural partial occlusion of lower legs/shoes stays; do not move it or invent hidden foot anatomy. Keep the proper depth and source human scale of this approved desk sitting, not the bench-chat scale.

Character remains exactly the correct youthful Soyo Nagasaki / 長崎そよ, It's MyGO!!!!!: long LIGHT BROWN softly curled hair, fine bangs and BLUE eyes, original navy Tsukinomori sailor blouse with broad WHITE collar/navy trim, gray-blue bow and small gold crest, navy pleated skirt with TWO white hem lines, dark knee socks, brown loafers. Keep her own original youthful face and ordinary proportions, clothing and hair silhouette; no mature model styling or borrowed face.

Only basic changed study action: both forearms receive real support from the existing desk. One hand lightly steadies the original page; the other holds one simple pen just above or touching that page, recording ONE small faint line in its margin. Lower the former near-chin thinking hand naturally to this supported desk task, with coherent wrist/elbow connections. Keep the original supported seated pelvis, knees and lower legs, no recrossing legs or reshaping the chair. Her gaze is now on the page, head inclined only a little, with both eyes naturally legible through her bangs. A small supplemental sheet can remain next to the original page. Faint abstract pencil/pen traces only, no readable problem, calendar, dates, names, schedule or completed-work label.

Retain the same clear-day apricot whole-room sunlight, natural skin/hair/navy/white local colors, gentle face shadow planes and soft real contact/compression at chair and shoes. Refined original anime linework and shading integrated with the literary room. No full-room redraw, gray/gold overlay, split light, sticker outline, new furniture, extra person/limb, UI, text caption, watermark, logo, collage, border, crop or fog.
